headline: Vertu wants CEOs to run companies from an AI foldable starting at $6,880
snapshot: Built on top of the open-source Hermes project, Vertu's new foldable combines AI-agent workflows, enterprise integrations, and ultra-premium luxury finishes. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.

live_newsroom.headline: In more good news for Amazon, Snowflake signs $6B deal with AWS for AI CPU chips
live_newsroom.snapshot: Snowflake has signed a new, enormous five-year deal with Amazon to secure chips for AI usage. Nvidia is once again being put on notice. The larger angle is AI infrastructure: compute capacity, chip access and data-center economics are increasingly determining which companies can scale products for enterprise and government customers.
